# Pling documentation

> Pling (Page Intelligence) is an open capability layer for real web applications. An agent executes explicitly declared page capabilities instead of guessing the DOM or bypassing business logic.

The protocol is `pling.surface/0.1` and remains a public draft. The only methods implemented by 0.1 are `describe` and `invoke`. Business failures stay inside a successful protocol response as `result.error`; protocol failures use `ok: false`.

Specification entry point: https://plingjs.dev/spec/0.1/. Full text: https://plingjs.dev/llms-full.txt.
